I answered from domain knowledge and did not run any analysis on the CSV. Pathophysiological findings such as radiculopathy typically cause symptoms such as shoulder problems, not the other way around. Cervical radiculopathy at C4 commonly refers pain to the shoulder region. So R C4 radiculopathy causing L shoulder problems (B) is more plausible than L shoulder problems causing R C4 radiculopathy (A).

ANSWER: B
